title: Design: the Manage Customers dialog and its tab tooltip
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales, so the Add tab has a row.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Click Manage Customers.
  5. Point at the Add Customers tab title.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Customers tab shows Manage Customers.

Step 4:

  • A dialog titled "Manage Customers on" and tier A's name opens over a dimmed page, with an X at the top right.
  • Tabs read Add Customers (selected) and Remove Customers with its count; a "Search customers" box sits under them.
  • The columns read a checkbox, Customer, Work Order Tier, Part Sales Tier and "Use" tier A's name "for".
  • The footer reads "No customers picked yet." at the left with Cancel and a grayed Add Customers at the right, as in picture 9.4.

Step 5:

  • A dark tooltip reads "Check the customers to put on" tier A's name ". Each one gets Work Orders and Part Sales unless you uncheck one, in the bar for everyone or on the customer's own row.", as in picture 9.5.
